evidence_sources.title: MultiSourceCrawler API Documentation
evidence_sources.synthesis: MultiSourceCrawler provides search_company_reports(company_name, year) method returning dict[str, list[CompanyReport]]. Incompatible with PipelineOrchestrator expectation of crawl_company(cik, year).
evidence_sources.relevance: Confirms need for adapter pattern to bridge API gap

evidence_sources.synthesis: PipelineOrchestrator line 229 calls self.crawler.crawl_company(company_cik, fiscal_year). Current state: self.crawler = None (line 98) will cause AttributeError at runtime.
evidence_sources.relevance: Validates hypothesis that crawler initialization prevents runtime failures

evidence_sources.synthesis: API /score endpoint currently hardcoded to use demo_flow. No conditional routing based on ALLOW_NETWORK. PipelineOrchestrator never invoked from API layer.
evidence_sources.relevance: Confirms need for auto-detection routing logic

evidence_sources.title: Docker Configuration Inconsistency
evidence_sources.synthesis: ALLOW_NETWORK defaults are inconsistent: docker-compose.yml=true, docker-compose.live.yml=false, Dockerfile=false, .env.example=false. Creates confusion about intended production behavior.

evidence_sources.title: Demo Flow Offline Capability
evidence_sources.synthesis: Demo flow has fallback logic for ALLOW_NETWORK=true via _build_bronze_from_live(). Demonstrates that offline/online dual-mode pattern already exists in codebase, just not formalized at API layer.

evidence_sources.title: Adapter Pattern (Gang of Four)
evidence_sources.source: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
evidence_sources.synthesis: Adapter pattern converts interface of class into another interface clients expect. Allows classes to work together despite incompatible interfaces. Recommended for bridging legacy systems or third-party APIs.

evidence_sources.title: TickerLookupProvider CIK Resolution
evidence_sources.synthesis: TickerLookupProvider can resolve CIK to company name via lookup_by_cik() method. Required for adapter to translate CIK-based orchestrator calls to name-based crawler calls.
evidence_sources.relevance: Confirms technical feasibility of CIK → name translation in adapter

evidence_sources.title: Task 010 PDF Extraction Failure
evidence_sources.synthesis: Task 010 documented that pipeline is currently SEC HTML-only, not universal. PDF extraction failed. Validates decision to focus Task 011 on SEC EDGAR live mode, not PDF ingestion.
evidence_sources.relevance: Scoping justification - defer PDF to future task

evidence_summary: Research confirms three critical gaps: (1) API method signature mismatch requiring adapter, (2) Uninitialized crawler in orchestrator causing runtime failures, (3) Hardcoded demo_flow in API preventing live mode. Configuration audit reveals inconsistent ALLOW_NETWORK defaults across Docker files. All gaps addressable via adapter pattern + auto-detection routing + config alignment.
